summary_en: Upper limit ¥3.0B, 1.2M shares (4.4% of shares outstanding ex-treasury), open-market purchase, Aug 14, 2026–Apr 30, 2027, intended for cancellation per Companies Act Art. 178.
title_en: Notice of Decision on Matters Relating to Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: CTI Engineering Co., Ltd. announced on 30 July 2026 that its Board of Resolutions approved the acquisition of up to 1.2 million treasury shares (4.4% of shares outstanding, excluding treasury) for an upper limit of ¥3.0 billion. The acquisition will be conducted via open-market purchase on the Tokyo Stock Exchange Prime Market between 14 August 2026 and 30 April 2027. The company stated that the buyback aligns with its mid-term management plan 2027, which emphasizes shareholder returns following progress on growth investments. The acquired shares are intended for cancellation under Companies Act Article 178. The company noted that market conditions may result in partial or non-execution of the program.
